The structure of MgSi₂ (Mg₄Si₈ per cell, 12 atoms, six independent Wyckoff orbits) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4₂/mnm (No. 143). Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Mg centers have 12 geometric neighbors (4 Mg, 8 Si), while Si centers show 12 neighbors, with neighbor counts varying per orbit. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Mg–Mg and Mg–Si 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Si–Si polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
